name: Soukan Chiryou Byoutou ~Nurse wa Mama De, Joi wa Oba
original_name: 相姦恥療病棟 ～ナースはママで、女医は叔母
source:
One day, Yuuji (the hero) made an appointment with his mother. But, she didn't come with him to the hospital – she worked there, along with her sister. Yuuji went to the hospital but was unsure of his mother's location. So he went to his aunt's office to ask.

As Yuuji reached the door to his aunt's office, he heard a strange noise. Inside, he couldn't believe what he saw...

Yuuji's mother was f**king her own sister with a strap-on dildo on her hospital desk!

[From DLsite English]
translation:
有一天，雄二（主人公）和他的母亲有个约会。但是，她没有和他一起去医院——她和她的姐姐一起在那里工作。雄二去了医院，但不确定母亲在哪里。于是，他就去姨妈的办公室询问。

当雄二走到姨妈办公室门口时，他听到了奇怪的声音。内心深处，他简直不敢相信自己所看到的……

雄二的母亲在医院的办公桌上用绑带假阳具操她自己的妹妹！
